title: gp-quantum-bottleneck-unet: Source code for global versus patch-wise quantum bottlenecks in U-Net mammographic mass segmentation
description: Code, fold assignments and external-test crop list for the study of global versus patch-wise quantum bottlenecks in U-Net mass segmentation on CBIS-DDSM, with size-matched classical and identity controls, severing tests and external testing on DMID.
